answer_1.quote: Magic Image aims to mitigate the over-refusal problem in MLLMs while enhancing model safety by optimizing an image as parallel input... As a result, models produce excessive unnecessary refusals to benign queries...
answer_1.outputs: model responses including refusals and generated content

answer_2.quote: To quantitatively evaluate the impact of Magic Image... we employ two metrics for evaluation: 1) Bert Scores... 2) Chat-GPT Scores...

answer_3.quote: 2) Chat-GPT Scores, which employ ChatGPT-4o to conduct semantic consistency evaluations on model outputs for benign samples.
